# Your app was down for ten minutes. Did you lose the payment webhook?

> Never lose a Stripe, GitHub or Shopify webhook because your app was down. Self-hosted relay that verifies signatures, saves events before answering, retries with backoff and replays on demand. Free, FSL-1.1-MIT, zero dependencies.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
